init.title: Options
init.description:
**Room history:** every hour NET-TRV reads each room's temperature and setpoint from Netatmo into long-term statistics (up to 30 days back the first time), so graphs have no gaps.

**Public weather:** weather from public Netatmo stations near you. The value is the median of all stations inside the circle, so one badly placed station does not skew it.

data_description.weather_location: Stations inside this circle are used. 1 km is a good start in a city; use more in the countryside.

set_schedule.name: Set heating schedule
set_schedule.description: Switches the home to another Netatmo heating schedule. Applies to every room.

schedule_name.name: Schedule
schedule_name.description: Name of the schedule as shown in the Netatmo app.

set_preset_mode_with_end_datetime.name: Set preset until
set_preset_mode_with_end_datetime.description: Away or frost guard for the whole home, or boost for this room, until the given time.

preset_mode.name: Preset
preset_mode.description: Away and frost guard apply to the whole home.

end_datetime.name: Until
end_datetime.description: When Netatmo returns to the schedule.

set_temperature_with_end_datetime.name: Set temperature until
set_temperature_with_end_datetime.description: Manual setpoint for the room until the given time.

end_datetime.name: Until
end_datetime.description: When the room returns to the schedule.

set_temperature_with_time_period.name: Set temperature for a while
set_temperature_with_time_period.description: Manual setpoint for the room for the given duration.

clear_temperature_setting.name: Clear temperature setting
clear_temperature_setting.description: Drops the manual setpoint; the room follows the schedule again.

register_webhook.name: Register webhook
register_webhook.description: Asks Netatmo to send real-time events to NET-TRV again.

unregister_webhook.name: Unregister webhook
unregister_webhook.description: Asks Netatmo to stop sending events. NET-TRV falls back to polling every 60 s.
